description: Retrieve one Agent-Rider catalog entry by its id, e.g. issue, verify. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use rider_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Agent-Rider catalog, e.g. issue, verify. Get the id list from rider_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: rider_get
